posts.zh:
dsh-autovision 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。纯文本 dsh 模型的识图插件：粘贴图片自动由你配置的多模态模型转成文字——透明孪生路由、模型可自主调用识图工具、无内置密钥与中转。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-783361b6dac20f58d7d9.html
posts.en:
dsh-autovision is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Vision for text-only dsh models: paste an image and a configured multimodal model transcribes it to text automatically — transparent twin routing, an agent-callable read-image tool, no built-in keys or relay.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-783361b6dac20f58d7d9.html
